# Upright Fencing Hawaii LLC

> Licensed fence contractor on Oahu, Hawaii. Founded in 1995 in Ewa Beach;
> shop in Kapolei since 2017. Residential, HOA, builder and commercial
> fencing and gates island-wide. Hawaii contractor license C-35900.

## What we do
- Vinyl fencing (privacy, semi-privacy, picket), lifetime manufacturer warranty on vinyl
- Aluminum fencing (pool and ornamental)
- Chain link fencing, residential and commercial
- Wood and redwood fencing
- Custom gates and gate operators, fabricated in our own shop
- Commercial and industrial fencing
- Temporary construction fencing
- In-house vinyl routing and gate fabrication

## Where we work
All of Oahu: Kapolei, Makakilo, Ewa Beach, Waipahu, Mililani, Pearl City,
Aiea, Wahiawa, Honolulu, Kailua, Kaneohe and the North Shore.

## Hours
Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-4:00 PM, by appointment. Closed weekends.
